summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an open-market share repurchase of 7,000,000 ordinary shares on 17 July 2026 at a volume-weighted average price of 110.5046 pence per share. The buyback is part of an existing program announced on 30 January 2026 and executed through Goldman Sachs International as broker. The shares will be cancelled, reducing the outstanding share count. This is a routine capital return activity under an ongoing buyback program, not a special situation such as a tender offer or going-private transaction.
